administrator.rule: automation may execute bounded duties; final production evolution requires explicit administrator approval

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes at minute 3 and manual
schedulers.responsibility: observe the whole control plane and report blockers without mutating production

schedulers.cadence: every 30 minutes, pull-request events, policy changes and manual
schedulers.responsibility: enforce branch, label, manifest and shadow-isolation policy

schedulers.cadence: every 120 minutes at minute 13 and manual
schedulers.responsibility: inventory research evidence and integration backlog without approving or merging

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes at minute 33 after server health, and manual
schedulers.responsibility: require a fresh healthy deployed incumbent, then merge at most one fully green administrator-approved integration pull request

schedulers.cadence: every 10 minutes as a reconciliation check, repository dispatch after integration, and manual
schedulers.responsibility: reconcile and dispatch exact-SHA code, monitoring and live-paper validation when main is ahead of paper-validated

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes, pull requests, main pushes and manual
schedulers.responsibility: Release and Debug build, deterministic tests and deployment contracts

schedulers.cadence: every 15 minutes, pull requests, main pushes and manual
schedulers.responsibility: validate exporter, dashboard and observability contracts

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes, pull requests, exact-SHA validation dispatch and manual
schedulers.responsibility: run public-data paper validation and advance paper-validated only after success

schedulers.cadence: every 30 minutes when private deployment is enabled, successful live-paper validation and manual
schedulers.responsibility: deploy the exact paper-validated revision and verify production paper services

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes at minute 23, post-deploy and manual
schedulers.responsibility: inspect deployed runtime, processes, observability and risk telemetry without changing code

schedulers.cadence: every 30 minutes, relevant changes and manual
schedulers.responsibility: collect isolated forward maker evidence only

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes at minute 2, relevant changes and manual
schedulers.responsibility: evaluate paper-only alpha challengers and publish durable evidence without mutating the live champion

schedulers.cadence: every 5 minutes, relevant changes and manual
schedulers.responsibility: coordinate bounded allowlisted remediation and relaunch stale schedulers without merge, deploy or champion mutation

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes at minute 7, relevant pull requests and manual
schedulers.responsibility: collect read-only fast-arbitrage market-data and cost-stressed shadow evidence without submitting orders

schedulers.cadence: every 60 minutes at minute 27 and manual
schedulers.responsibility: re-derive arbitrage candidates from valid shadow evidence and materialize research-only proposals under cost stress

schedulers.cadence: every 360 minutes at minute 57 and manual
schedulers.responsibility: check read-only Gamma and CLOB API connectivity
